intro: Belarus has a largely state-run economy that depends heavily on Russia.

chapters.title: Trucks, tractors and potash
text: Belarus builds tractors and giant mining dump trucks, including some of the largest in the world, and is a major producer of potash fertiliser. It refines Russian oil.

chapters.title: Tech and sanctions
text: A once-thriving tech scene produced the game World of Tanks and the messaging app Viber, but many IT workers left after 2020. Western sanctions have pushed Belarus even closer to Russia.

keyTerms.meaning: A potassium-rich salt used as fertiliser.
